attributes.action: Open Roads back up in Greater London
attributes.additional_details: The main roads in greater london are extremely congested in the mornings and evenings during rush hours, they can also become congested due to a myriad of other causes - crashes, roadworks, incorrectly stopped vehicles. My petition is to revise the closure of side roads and reopen them so they can be used by vehicles, even if it just for the rush hour times.
attributes.background: To reopen closed side roads for use by cars instead of making a system where main roads are extremely congested and side roads can’t be used.

rejection.details: We can't accept your petition because the UK Government and Parliament aren't responsible for the issue you raise. This is a matter for TfL and the local authorities.
